recognize_zh: 多顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質淡藍到深藍、邊緣可見小突起，細胞核圓或不規則（右下呈腎形），染色質中度緻密且多數可見單一明顯核仁，這種「成熟染色質加上清楚核仁」的組合是 T-PLL 前淋巴球的特徵。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than small lymphocytes
Moderate N:C ratio with a rim of basophilic cytoplasm; some cells with small cytoplasmic protrusions/blebs
Round to irregular nuclei, including a reniform/folded nucleus at lower right
Moderately condensed chromatin with a single visible nucleolus in many cells
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis including a teardrop-shaped cell
describe_en: Smear shows numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of basophilic agranular cytoplasm, some with small cytoplasmic protrusions. Nuclei are round to irregular, including a reniform form, with moderately condensed chromatin and a single distinct nucleolus in many cells. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. These prolymphocytes with mature chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli are consistent with the stated diagnosis of T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation requires T-cell immunophenotyping and TCL1A/inv(14) studies.

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes appear similar with prominent nucleoli but have rounder nuclei and a B-cell phenotype (CD19/CD20, sIg bright) without TCL1A rearrangement.
Blasts show finely dispersed, immature chromatin and express TdT/CD34, whereas prolymphocytes have partially condensed mature chromatin.
ATLL cells are polylobated 'flower cells' with dense chromatin and typically lack nucleoli, with HTLV-1 seropositivity.
LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules and round nuclei without nucleoli.
